svg.title: How the six Skills work together
svg.desc: Paper reading is an optional evidence input to analysis and writing. A five-node main route supports preflight, analysis, interpretation, plotting and writing; authorization and MSI are explicit analysis branches.

text.font-family: "DejaVu Sans Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
"DejaVu Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

svg.text: How the six Skills work together

text.font-family: "DejaVu Sans", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Enter at any point. The main route is a guide, not a requirement.
